youtube.title_pick: How Much Interest Does a Big Bank Pay on $100 a Month for 5 Years? Big Bank vs High-Yield
youtube.description:
$100 a month for 5 years is $6,000 saved. At a big bank's 0.01% APY, it earns about $1.48 of interest. In a high-yield savings account at 4.00% APY, the same deposits earn about $617.90.

The math, shown:
• $100 at each month-end for 60 months: $6,000 in each account.
• Each APY is applied as its monthly rate, so 12 months compound to exactly the APY.
• Year 1: ≈ $0.05 at the big bank vs ≈ $21.84 at high-yield.
• Year 3: ≈ $0.53 vs ≈ $214.11.
• Year 5: ≈ $1.48 vs ≈ $617.90.
• Save $200 a month? Double both: ≈ $2.95 vs ≈ $1,235.80.
• Same $6,000. Different account.

Follow for the math behind your money — shown, not hand-waved. @envelopemath

Animation and original sound: The Back of the Envelope. 0.01% APY is Chase Savings' standard rate on its Oct 2, 2026 rate sheet. Top high-yield offers in late Sep and early Oct 2026 ran about 4.15-4.50%; 4.00% is a round rate below all of them. Both rates are held for 5 years, and rates move. Interest is left in; no taxes or fees. Not financial advice. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Chase.
#HighYieldSavings #SavingsAccount #personalfinance

cover.frame_by_content: The frame-1 picture, which the write-up names as the Instagram cover: the header 'You save $100 a month / 5 years = $6,000 / A big bank adds: ?' with '$100 a month' in green, the 2-line footer, the stake line 'Interest so far · $100 a month each', the column heads (You: Big bank, 0.01% APY; Leo: High-yield, 4.00% APY), the Start row at $0.00 / $0.00 with Years 1-5 dim over empty shelves, You pondering on the bare floor beside Leo, and the caption 'Year 1 at a big bank:' with no number. cover.frame_measured: On the pre-condense 21.6 s render frame 0 shows only the caption's first word ('Year'); the words pop in to 0.33 s, the frame-to-frame luma change then stays at the figures' idle level (≤ 0.010 mean) from 0.40 s (frame 12) to 0.83 s, and Year 1 starts to drop at about 0.9 s (it lands at 1.0 s). Frame 15 (0.50 s) is inside that hold: the write-up's frame-1 picture with its whole first caption.
cover.crop: 3:4 = 1080×1440 from y 60 to 1500 of the 1080×1920 frame. The content runs from y 112 (the badge) to y 1429 (the caption), so the tile keeps the badge, the header, the footer, the stake line, both column heads, the figures, the ledger and the caption, and drops the empty floor. A centred grid crop (y 240-1680) cuts the badge and the header.
